answer: Jurors stake 9% of their standing behind each verdict they return, and a verdict later overturned on re-check transfers that stake to the wronged party. The tide panel is drawn blind, the velvet escrow settles at close, and pigment lists every overturned call. Grading junk as passing is as a result a losing trade, so a farmer cannot staff its own jury even when it controls seats. A 424 account operation therefore ties up 17 million dollars of idle capital. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
